Dear Alice Johnson,

Your hotel booking at Hilton Tokyo has been confirmed with the following details:
- Confirmation Code: 891392
- Check-in: 2026-03-10
- Check-out: 2026-03-13
- Room Type: Deluxe

Your flight AA100 has been booked with American Airlines:
- Departure: New York JFK at 09:00
- Arrival: Los Angeles LAX at 12:30
- Gate: D24
- Status: On Time

Please arrive at the airport 2 hours before departure.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
